data.description:
## Context
Import help still describes duplicate creation and future batching. ADR 0039 and `cold-stall-chalk` delivered an import-only batching carveout, deferred push, and source-based resumption. The current implementation does not provide whole-file atomicity or automatic repair for every partial import.

## Plan
- Update canonical import parser help before generated artifacts.
- Document 256-event chunks for independent create, parent, file-impact or verify-command, and comment passes.
- State that link and status passes remain per-event.
- Document deferred push after successful import work.
- Document serial `source_id` skipping, incomplete-ticket risk after a crash between passes, and concurrent duplicate risk when scans race.
- Regenerate packaged help and the CLI reference.
- Correct `docs/import-export.md` without changing importer behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Canonical and generated help describe current batching and push behavior.
- [ ] User guidance describes partial results and supported rerun behavior.
- [ ] Guidance promises neither whole-file atomicity nor automatic completion of partial tickets.
- [ ] Concurrent-import limitations are explicit.
- [ ] Focused parser, generator, and import documentation tests pass.
- [ ] Import runtime behavior is unchanged.
data.title: F10 document import batching and partial recovery
